Do not swallow or ingest. Before using Travatan eye drops, inform your doctor if you are pregnant, planning on becoming pregnant, breastfeeding, and about your complete medical history. Uses Travatan eye drops are used to decrease the fluid pressure inside the eye in patients suffering from glaucoma and high pressure in the eyes (ocular hypertension). Contraindications If you are allergic to travoprost or any other ingredients of Travatan eye drops. Side effects Eye pain Dry eyes Eye irritation Eye itching Precautions and Warnings Pregnancy Can I use Travatan eye drops during pregnancy? Travatan eye drops should not be used during pregnancy unless recommended by the doctor after assessing the need and the risk.
